text_block_list.text:
On our day off, Hokko Tarumae and I
arrived in front of the train station.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I've been thinking this for a while, but this town is actually pretty bustling, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Towns naturally develop
and expand outward from the station...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: In other words, observing the area around the station might give us a clue for developing the town!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, care to join me?
Let's learn together about revitalizing Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: When it comes to facilities near the station, this would be the one.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Direct access from the station, yet with a stylish and iconic exterior... got it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There really are a lot of young people here...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Students use the station often, and there's promotional buzz from social media too, so it's probably bustling all the time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Whoa... so high-class...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I wonder if facilities like this and famous brands are essential to attracting people...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A famous brand-name shop... huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It really seems that convenient locations and shops bustling with young people are effective for attracting crowds.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, calling them right away
would be difficult too, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...Flashy things like that just feel a bit... off for Tomakomai, I guess..."

As she pondered, an elderly man carrying a camera
walked past her.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text: "You really can take lively photos of the birds from here."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man B
text_block_list.text:
The birds still keep this place lively.
It's been the best place around since way back when.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The greatest place... unchanged since long ago.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...You're right, a town's charm doesn't just come from bustling shops."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even in Tomakomai, there are plenty of places
whose charm lies in remaining just the way they are...!
choice_data_list: Looks like you got something out of it, huh.
Looks like you got something out of it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The town of Tomakomai is
already a charming place.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "If they can just come visit once and see it with their own eyes, I know they'll feel its charm!"
choice_data_list: Then we've got to perform even better and get the word out.
Then we've got to perform even better and get the word out.
Hearing about it makes me want to go.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "If they can just come visit once and see it with their own eyes, I know they'll feel its charm!"
choice_data_list: Then we've got to perform even better and get the word out.
Then we've got to perform even better and get the word out.
Hearing about it makes me want to go.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You're right! I've gotta share all the great things about Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling really motivated now!
I've got to work hard toward the next race right away!
Having gained new insights, Hokko Tarumae worked even harder than before.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Really?
What part made you think that!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If I could just figure that out,
it would make promoting it so much easier than it is now...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Please be more specific.
This is for the sake of revitalizing the town!"
Pressed by an eager Hokko Tarumae, after a moment, I managed to give an answer that satisfied her.
